seal: derivflow Step 3 — scale-law discrimination at n = 16384
parent_seal: RATE_QUESTION_SEAL.json (95e1ad3) + scope v1.5.1/v1.6 instrument; this seal adds ONE new measurement and changes nothing else
grade: SEALED-PROCEDURE, DISCLOSED-PRIOR-LOOK (the three anchor k* values and the full v1.6 adjudication have been seen; the n = 16384 point has never been computed at any instrument version)
question: Is k*(n) flat (O(1)) or proportional-logarithmic in n? Three anchors bound (alpha <~ 0.1) but cannot split these; n = 16384 can.

predictions_rederived_from_repo.source: science_dense_grid.json kstar_table (v1.6 dense adjudication), re-derived 2026-08-12 — NOT conversation-level arithmetic; the conversation numbers ('~13.2', '~12+ affine') were checked and corrected: an affine log fit through the near-flat anchors is non-identifiable (predicts 10.97, dumping growth into the intercept), so the sealed log hypothesis is PROPORTIONAL growth anchored at n = 4096

iid.sigma_sys_note: std of the three anchors; the flat model's chi2 = 27.9/2 dof shows real n-to-n scatter beyond fit errors (anchors are NON-monotone); sigma_sys absorbs it — filed openly, not hidden in the fit errors

design.rng_protocol: SeedSequence(20260811).spawn(128): children 96-111 = iid n=16384; children 112-127 = GUE n=16384 (if-time arm). Children 0-95 are NEVER reused.
design.instrument: v1.5.1 corrected reference (per-gap quadrature, Richardson primary, eps_k rule), fit machinery and window rule unchanged; multi-start fitter inherited
design.arm_order_predecided: iid FIRST and alone sufficient for the sealed question; GUE arm runs only after the iid arm completes and only if budget allows — scope creep on the run is pre-declined. If the box dies mid-GUE, the iid verdict stands.
design.readout: k*(16384) = fitted-curve crossing of 1 - <rtilde> = 1e-2 from the primary-arm F3 fit (same kstar machinery), with measurement error sigma_m from the fit-covariance draw method

adjudication.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else — including intermediate affine-log behavior, which this design deliberately does not claim to resolve; carries the mandatory power statement (the separation that WAS resolvable at the achieved sigma_eff)
adjudication.sanity: with sigma_m ~ 0.03-0.09 and sigma_sys = 0.192, sigma_eff ~ 0.20: 3*sigma_eff ~ 0.59 and 5*sigma_eff ~ 0.98 against separation 1.88 — the two acceptance bands cannot overlap; the design cannot produce a double-positive
adjudication.form_consistency_rider: the F3 selection at 16384 is reported (band triple per v1.5.1) but does NOT gate the scale verdict; a form flip at 16384 would be filed as its own finding

paper_inclusion_rule_cross_ref: ROADMAP Step 4 pre-commitment (2026-08-12): the paper ships on its pinned date with whatever scale-law state exists then — sealed verdict if landed, three-n's bounded-not-resolved if not. This seal does not hold the paper hostage.
